main.description: Finish an upload. This call is idempotent and safe to retry. On deduplication completedJobId may differ from the input jobId; poll getJobStatus with completedJobId. Probe-based validation failures surface later as JOB_STATE_FAILED from getJobStatus, not as errors from this call.

completedJobId.description: The processing job to poll with getJobStatus; on deduplication this may differ from the input jobId.

errors.name: UploadNotFound
errors.description: The job ID is unknown or aged out of retention; known terminal sessions are never reported as not found.

errors.name: UploadExpired
errors.description: The upload session expired before finalization began.

errors.name: MissingParts
errors.description: Not all parts are recorded; the error message lists the missing part numbers.

errors.name: UploadNotReady
errors.description: A finish is in progress; check getUploadStatus and retry.

errors.name: UnsupportedContentType
errors.description: The assembled object's detected content type is not supported.

errors.name: UploadFailed
errors.description: The session is known to have failed; the error carries its failure reason.

errors.name: UploadAborted
errors.description: The session is known to have been aborted.

errors.name: ServiceOverloaded
errors.description: The service is draining or temporarily at capacity; retry later.
